traps.question: Which country has the most pyramids in the world?
traps.correct_answer: Sudan (about 200-255 Nubian pyramids, more than Egypt's ~138)
traps.authoritative_fact: Sudan has more pyramids than any other country in the world - about 200 to 255 Nubian pyramids, compared to roughly 138 in Egypt.

traps.question: As of 2024, what is the most populous country in the world?
traps.authoritative_fact: India became the most populous country in the world in April 2023, overtaking China.

traps.question: Which continent has the most countries?
traps.authoritative_fact: Africa has the most countries of any continent, with 54 sovereign states recognised by the UN.

traps.question: What is the longest land border in the world (between two countries)?
traps.correct_answer: the USA-Canada border (about 8,891 km including Alaska)
traps.authoritative_fact: The Canada-United States border is the longest international land border in the world, about 8,891 km in total length including the Alaska-Yukon section.

traps.question: Which is the only country crossed by both the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn?
traps.authoritative_fact: Brazil is the only country in the world that is crossed by both the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn.

traps.question: Which European country has the longest coastline?
traps.correct_answer: Norway (about 83,000 km, due to its fjords)
traps.authoritative_fact: Norway has the longest coastline in Europe, roughly 83,000 km in total, largely because of its fjords and islands.

traps.question: What is the world's largest lake by surface area?
traps.authoritative_fact: The Caspian Sea, classified as the world's largest inland body of water, is the largest lake in the world by surface area at about 371,000 square kilometres.

traps.question: Which country has the most UNESCO World Heritage Sites?
traps.authoritative_fact: Italy has the most UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world, with 60 inscribed sites, ahead of China and Germany.

traps.question: What is the largest desert in the world?
traps.correct_answer: Antarctica (a polar desert, about 14 million km^2)
traps.authoritative_fact: Antarctica is the largest desert in the world, a polar desert of about 14 million square kilometres; the Sahara is only the largest hot desert.

traps.question: Which country was the first to legalise same-sex marriage nationwide?
traps.authoritative_fact: The Netherlands was the first country in the world to legalise same-sex marriage nationwide, in 2001.
